title: Crash Landing
description:
Deal 21 damage to ALL enemies.
Fill your [gold]Hand[/gold] with [gold]Debris[/gold].
upgraded_description:
Deal 26 damage to ALL enemies.
Fill your [gold]Hand[/gold] with [gold]Debris[/gold].
notes: Fills all remaining hand slots with Debris cards (Status cards with Exhaust keyword). The number of Debris cards generated equals the difference between max hand size and current hand size.
